scope: Root-authorized four PR contract paths only; no stage, commit or remote mutation by inventory agent.

validation.previousFindings: Fixed stale event body and @OWNER/consecutive-hyphen owner validation.

behavior.currentMode: Reads validated current-repository GitHub API only; compares current PR number and head to event, validates current body. Refuses redirects and fails closed on network/JSON/size errors without token/body reflection.
behavior.offlineMode: Explicitly labelled event-snapshot-only; no freshness claim.
behavior.authority: Assurance is metadata at fetch instant; later edits require another check. No execution, human approval, scientific readiness, integration or merge authority is granted.

notChecked: Actual new GitHub workflow run and current API permissions after candidate push
